# ControllerTesting.com

> Free browser-based controller and gamepad diagnostic suite. Test stick drift, buttons, triggers, vibration, polling rate, deadzone, and more — no download required.

ControllerTesting.com is an independent hardware diagnostic platform built on the Web Gamepad API, WebHID API, Web MIDI API, and Web Audio API. All processing is 100% client-side; no game controller input data leaves your device.

## Core Diagnostic Tools (39 total)

### Controller Diagnostics
- [Stick Drift Detector](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/drift) — Detects analog stick drift to 0.1% precision
- [Full Diagnostic Wizard](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/full-diagnostic) — 5-step hardware health checkup (2 minutes)
- [Controller Health Score](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/health-score) — 0–100 grade with printable PDF report
- [Button Tester](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/buttons) — Tests every button for ghosting and response
- [Trigger Pressure Tester](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/triggers) — Analog L2/R2 pressure curve analysis
- [Vibration Tester](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/vibration) — Dual haptic motor pulse testing
- [Circularity Test](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/circularity) — 360° stick range-of-motion and error
- [Deadzone Visualizer](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/deadzone) — Inner and outer deadzone threshold tuning
- [Polling Rate Checker](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/polling-rate) — Real-time Hz input report frequency
- [Latency Estimator](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/latency) — Input delay and reaction speed timer
- [Gyroscope Tester](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/gyroscope) — 3-axis motion sensor calibration
- [Touchpad Tester](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/touchpad) — PS5 DualSense multi-touch trackpad
- [PS5 DualSense Tester](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/ps5) — PS5-specific diagnostics
- [Xbox Controller Tester](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/xbox) — Xbox-specific diagnostics
- [Nintendo Switch Tester](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/nintendo-switch) — Switch-specific diagnostics
- [Multi-Controller Tester](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/multi) — Up to 4 gamepads simultaneously
- [Competitive Readiness](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/competitive-readiness) — Esports tournament benchmark
- [PS WebHID Calibration](https://controllertesting.com/test/controller/ps-calibration) — Low-level firmware zero-point calibration

### Mouse Diagnostics
- [CPS Test](https://controllertesting.com/test/mouse/cps) — Clicks per second speed tester
- [Mouse Polling Rate](https://controllertesting.com/test/mouse/polling-rate) — Up to 8000Hz report rate checker
- [DPI Analyzer](https://controllertesting.com/test/mouse/dpi) — True hardware DPI calculator
- [Double-Click Fault Test](https://controllertesting.com/test/mouse/double-click) — Switch bounce and chatter detector

## Reliability Data

All reliability figures are explicitly labeled as **modeled reference baselines** derived from engineering estimates, not from measured datasets. Community telemetry collection is opt-in and starts at 0 samples.

- [Reliability Dashboard](https://controllertesting.com/reliability/dashboard) — Aggregate baselines across 5 controller models
- [Testing Methodology](https://controllertesting.com/test/methodology) — What browser tests can and cannot measure

### Reference Baselines (modeled, snapshot 2026-08-02)
- PS5 DualSense: 4.8% avg drift after 12 months
- Xbox Series X/S: 5.2% avg drift after 12 months
- Nintendo Switch Pro: 3.1% avg drift after 12 months
- Hall Effect Controllers: 0.1% avg drift after 12 months (36-month lifespan)

## Key Facts
- 39 free browser-based diagnostic tools
- 0 downloads or accounts required
- 100% client-side: no controller input data leaves your device
- Supports: PS5 DualSense, PS4 DualShock, Xbox Series, Switch Pro, Joy-Con, Fight Stick, Flight HOTAS, MIDI keyboards, PC mice
- 10 locales: en, es, de, fr, ja, pt, ko, ru, zh-tw, it
